postmark_steps: Create Transactional message stream named outbound
Note Server API Token (store as env var POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN — never commit)
Add domain pariscomedy.com under Sender Signatures
Copy DKIM TXT value (selector pm._domainkey, unique to your account)
porkbun_dns_steps: Update SPF TXT on @ to add include:spf.protection.postmark.com
Add DKIM TXT at pm._domainkey with value from Postmark
Add CNAME pm-bounces pointing to pm.mtasv.net

dns_records.target: (copy from Postmark Sender Signatures dashboard — unique to your account)
v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@pariscomedy.com; sp=none; adkim=r; aspf=r

safety.POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN: must NOT be committed to repo
